title: `sessionCounter` check not enforced when removing `SessionKeyValidator`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  When users remove `SessionKeyValidator`, it will ensure that `sessionCounter` is 0 before triggering `removeModuleValidator` and `removeHook` to complete the module removal.
